notes:
Deleting a use case (as built). Two steps, both drawn here:

1. **More menu.** The detail header's More button (`chrome-icon-btn`, icon `more_horiz`, `aria-label` "More actions", `aria-haspopup="menu"`) opens a menu (`chrome-menu-item` rows, popover anchored under the button, right-aligned) with one item: leading icon `delete` + "Delete use case". Drawn behind the scrim to show the anchor; in the build the menu closes when the item is picked.
2. **Confirmation** — native modal `<dialog>`, 520px, the shared dialog shell: title "Delete use case", text `Delete "<title>"? Its file is removed. This cannot be undone here (the project history keeps it when auto-commit is on).`, footer **Cancel** (autofocus — the safe action has the focus) and **Delete use case** (danger text). Esc / close = Cancel.

After delete: toast "Use case deleted.", the list reloads and the detail shows the placeholder "Select a use case." (no auto-selection). A failing delete shows the server message as a toast and keeps the use case.

Flows: close / Cancel → `usecases-detail`; Delete use case → `usecases-list`.
